method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the claimant), with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING where it does not answer); the rules in one module (the only one importing daydate), the questions in a seat module importing them; two regulative rules (s 231(2) MUST on Comcare, s 273 SHANT on the business) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. A new layer beside baseline-2026-10, which is untouched. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Health and Safety Act 2011, Compilation No. 16, compilation date 1 July 2024 (register id C2024C00243, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2011A00137.txt. Schedule 4 cl 2 tier A and tier F amounts as printed, before cl 4 indexation.

seat: the claimant: the worker, prospective worker or other person punished, pressured or misled for a safety reason (Part 6); the injured worker or family member who wants a prosecution brought (ss 231, 232); the worker affected by an inspector's or Comcare's decision (Part 12); the person whose loss an inspector's powers caused (s 184); the worker with a contract term or a charge about safety (ss 267, 272, 273) (whs-claims-seat.l4)
